verdict: Avoid new pharma/API exposure in Rudrapur for now; lend only to established, diversified formulation-linked units with tight structure, and decline small single-customer API/CRAMS units.
title: Rudrapur Pharmaceuticals & APIs: a note to the credit manager
narrative:
## What this business physically is
**A Rudrapur API or formulation unit buys solvents, intermediates and imported raw material, runs reactors or blending lines, and sells to formulators or exports.** Cash is made on conversion margin and asset turns, not on pricing power: most small units are price-takers quoting against Chinese import parity, and India imports 65-70% of its API requirement from China [9]. So when a proposal lands, check whether the borrower sells on a formula-linked contract or a spot quote; if spot, ask what happens to margin if import parity falls. ## Where cash actually sits
**Working capital, not capex, is where these units die.** Peer rating work shows working capital intensity of 47-52% of sales even after improvement, driven by elongated receivables and high inventory holding [8]. A mid-size peer carries ₹420 crore of fund-based limits with utilisation falling from 70-90% to 40-50% [7]. So take the receivables ageing and inventory days every month; if receivables cross the borrower's stated credit period, ask for the top-five buyer ledger before any enhancement. ## What has changed now
**The local economy is weaker than India, and the data call is Avoid.** Uttarakhand GST collections are -19.1% Apr-to-date against India +6.1%, 25.2 pp slower [D], and electricity demand is +4.7% against India +9.5% [D]. Nationally, bank credit is +21.6% YoY while output is -2.1% [D] — money is chasing a shrinking base. Note the local source is only a directory listing of 21 API suppliers in Udham Singh Nagar with no date [1]; we have no city-level pharma sales, capacity or export figure, so collect from customer. ## Where the growth is — and who to avoid
**Pursue formulation-linked API units and CDMO suppliers riding the China-plus-one shift.** The API industry grew 8.4% CAGR CY2017-CY2022E and is expected near 7% ahead [9]; peers confirm the pull — Aarti Pharmalabs posted record quarterly revenue of ₹613 crore, up 47% YoY, EBITDA margin 22.2% [2][4], and RPG Life Sciences targets 25% API CAGR [3]. ## How to grow safely
**Structure for the working-capital cycle, not the plant.** Fund inventory and receivables against a drawing-power limit with monthly stock-and-book-debt statements, and keep term debt back-ended as peers do [7]. Take monthly GST returns, top-five customer and supplier concentration, and reactor capacity utilisation. Early warning: receivable days stretching two months running, or limit utilisation jumping from 40-50% toward 90% [7] — then freeze enhancement and re-price.
watch: two months of falling turnover vs same month last year -> ask for order book and hold enhancement
top-five buyer days stretch beyond stated credit period -> seek ledger and buyer confirmation
utilisation moves from 40-50% toward 90% [7] -> freeze limits and review drawing power
single buyer above a third of sales -> ask for contract tenor and diversify plan
further divergence from India -> shift new sanctions to diversified formulation-linked units
